text_block_list.text: I let Oguri Cap know that fan mail had arrived for her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter for me...?
I see... That makes me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...So there are people here
who support me too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hearing cheers makes me happy, but letters
last forever, after all...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was in my hometown,
I would reread those letters for encouragement...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Alright. For the sake of everyone supporting me, I have to do my best and show them a great run.
